headline: Roofs and siding in Montgomery County, with 35 years behind the crew.
subhead: GK's Construction is a licensed and insured roofing and exterior contractor in Gaithersburg. James Hardie certified siding installers, GAF and CertainTeed roofing systems, free inspections, and emergency storm response across Montgomery, Prince George's and Frederick counties.
services_lead: Roofing first, then the rest of the exterior.

services.name: Roof replacement
services.blurb: Full tear-off of aging roofs with decking inspection and plywood replaced where needed.

services.name: Roof installation
services.blurb: New roofs in the material you choose, with underlayment, ice barrier and ridge vents; most homes done in one to three days.

services.name: Roof repair and storm response
services.blurb: Routine repairs plus rapid assessment and temporary weatherproofing after a storm.

services.name: Free roof inspections
services.blurb: Free inspection and consultation; annual checks advised for roofs over 20 years old.

services.name: Siding
services.blurb: Vinyl, James Hardie fiber cement, wood and insulated siding installed, replaced or repaired, permits handled, financing offered.

services.name: Interior remodeling
services.blurb: Kitchens, bathrooms, basements and interior upgrades.
